image_policy: Resolve build-spec-verified local image to immutable ID for execution
transport: Startup command-line request; length-prefixed console response; NOT interactive Run control
privilege: UID/GID 65534, all capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, no privileged container
filesystem: Read-only root and bind inputs; compile scratch in bounded tmpfs; no checkout/credentials/Docker socket mounted
clocks: Stock wall/monotonic clocks and native CPU counters are NOT mediated
metering: Wall watchdog only; no reproducible instruction budget
